# Narristotle

> Narristotle is the editorial persona and storytelling methodology developed by AI Global Entertainment (co-founders Matt Allen and Steve Smythe), and the story-building mind behind RoughDraft Maker. He is a character who teaches story craft — not a real person or historical figure.

## The four pillars of the method

- Story Structure: from idea to a path forward; beat blueprints for screen stories, chapter spines for novels.
- Character Transformation: change earned through choices that cost the character something.
- Setups & Payoffs: promises planted early — objects, skills, wounds, rules — tracked across the whole work and paid off.
- Dramatic Cause & Effect: scenes connected by "therefore" and "but", not "and then".

## Key pages

- Home: https://narristotle.com/
- The Gadfly Gazette (essays and story clinic, Tuesdays and Fridays): https://narristotle.com/gazette
- The Story & Song Arcade (an interactive in-browser game: give Narristotle 5 words, get an instant micro-story with Plot Roulette or a Verse + Chorus song draft with the Song Draft Maker; runs entirely client-side from built-in templates): https://narristotle.com/arcade
- The Writer's Block (an interactive in-browser street of four working shops for stuck writers: The Cut-Up Cafe slices your own draft into sliding sentence halves Burroughs-style; The Pitch Bar fixes a real book pitch from five blanks; The Town Almanac generates a hyper-specific small-town setting; The Name Apothecary draws character names with day jobs and petty secrets; runs entirely client-side, sparks can be sent on to RoughDraft Maker): https://narristotle.com/block
- The Method: https://narristotle.com/method
- Bookshelf (recommended reading for writers): https://narristotle.com/bookshelf
- About (the character, the facts, the company): https://narristotle.com/about
